claim.text: The retained METR count_odds run is intact, the Flywheel import reruns all three controls, and the import rejects a score changed after the recorded hash.

control.description: Change one byte of a file the packet manifest lists; the packet's own manifest check must fail. The packet's verifier also runs its built-in changed-score control on every run, and ok: true requires that control to be refused with SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH.

covers: The 54 packet file hashes, the source pin of the Flywheel importer at b3ec822b, the import rerun of the correct, wrong and no-submission controls, and the changed-score control.
does_not_cover: The upstream run itself. The verifier does not rebuild METR's task image or rerun the Inspect bridge; the GitHub Actions run metadata and image digests inside the packet are third-party records it reads, not reruns.
notes: Windows: the pinned checkout is made with core.autocrlf=false and core.longpaths=true. With autocrlf=true the importer source pins fail, because the packet pins the LF bytes Git stores.
